categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures and sells automotive seat fabrics and synthetic leather, with over 90% of sales from automotive seat fabric production. It also produces furniture fabrics and other related textile products. The business focuses on supplying materials for automotive interiors and furniture upholstery.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced textile manufacturing technologies including lamination (LAMIFABRIC), tricot, woven, and circular knit (C/KNIT) fabric production. It has established multiple technology transfer agreements with international partners for automotive interior fabric design and production. The company emphasizes eco-friendly and functional material development, including flame retardant and recycled materials, supported by an in-house R&D center with specialized equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major automobile manufacturers such as Hyundai, Kia, Renault Samsung, and GH, primarily in the automotive industry. The company also serves furniture manufacturers and exports to international markets. The automotive seat fabric market is oligopolistic with intense competition and high entry barriers due to quality and safety standards.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Ansan and Iksan, and has a subsidiary in China. It has engaged in technology partnerships and contracts with companies in France, Japan, China, Austria, India, Indonesia, and previously Brazil. Export sales contribute significantly to revenue, indicating a global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the automotive supply chain, producing intermediate materials (seat fabrics and synthetic leather) used by automotive OEMs for vehicle interiors. It works closely with automakers in product development and supply, reflecting a supplier role within the automotive manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing eco-friendly, high-quality, and functional automotive and furniture fabrics. R&D focuses on sustainable materials such as bio-based and recycled textiles, flame retardant fabrics, and advanced synthetic leathers. The company invests in design diversification and quality optimization through international technology collaborations and maintains a dedicated research institute.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of automotive seat fabrics, synthetic leather, and furniture fabrics. Sales channels include direct supply contracts with automakers and furniture manufacturers, with domestic and export sales. Payment terms vary by domestic orders (mostly cash and promissory notes) and export sales (cash, irrevocable letters of credit).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly concentrated automotive seat fabric industry with few dominant players due to high technical and quality barriers. It maintains strong relationships with major automakers and leverages technology partnerships to sustain competitiveness. The market is characterized by intense competition and price pressure from OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 32.58 billion KRW, a 3% increase from the previous year, with an operating loss of 1.49 billion KRW, significantly reduced from prior years. Total assets stood at about 31 billion KRW with liabilities of 28 billion KRW, reflecting a high debt ratio. The company is in a mature market with modest growth and ongoing efforts to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, eco-friendly automotive interior fabrics and synthetic leathers that meet stringent safety and environmental regulations. It differentiates through advanced design capabilities, functional material development, and close collaboration with automakers for tailored solutions. Its commitment to sustainability and innovation in materials provides competitive advantage in a demanding market.
